mapper.select:
SELECT Q.QNA_NO AS qnaNo, Q.PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, Q.QNA_TITLE AS qnaTitle, Q.Q_CONTENTS AS qContents, Q.IS_SECRET AS isSecret, Q.ANS_STATUS AS ansStatus,
Q.USER_ID AS userId, Q.CDATE AS cdate,
U.USER_NAME AS userName, U.NICKNAME AS nickname
FROM QNA Q LEFT JOIN PRODUCT P ON Q.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO
LEFT JOIN USERS U ON Q.USER_ID = U.USER_ID
WHERE Q.ANS_STATUS = 'N' ORDER BY Q.QNA_NO DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE QNA SET A_CONTENTS = #{aContents}, ANS_STATUS = 'Y' WHERE QNA_NO = #{qnaNo}
mapper.select: SELECT S.STORE_NO AS storeNo, SU.S_USER_ID AS sUserId, SU.CEO_NAME AS ceoName, SU.BIZ_FILE_NAME AS bizFileName, S.STORE_NAME AS storeName, S.S_CATEGORY AS sCategory, S.S_ADDR AS sAddr, S.S_FULL_ADDR AS sFullAddr, S.LAT AS lat, S.LNG AS lng, SU.U_STATUS AS uStatus, S.S_STATUS AS sStatus, SS.SUBMIT_STATUS AS submitStatus FROM STORE_SUBMIT SS INNER JOIN STORE S ON SS.STORE_NO = S.STORE_NO INNER JOIN STORE_USER SU ON SS.S_USER_ID = SU.S_USER_ID WHERE SS.SUBMIT_STATUS = 'PND' AND S.S_STATUS = 'PND' AND SU.U_STATUS = 'PND' ORDER BY S.STORE_NO DESC

SELECT RR.REPORT_NO AS reportNo, RR.REVIEW_NO AS reviewNo, R.USER_ID AS userId, RR.REPORTER_ID AS reporterId, RR.REP_STATUS AS repStatus, R.R_CONTENTS AS rContents, ( SELECT CONCAT(RF.FILE_PATH, RF.FILE_NAME) FROM REVIEW_FILE RF WHERE RF.REVIEW_NO = R.REVIEW_NO ORDER BY RF.FILE_NO ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS filePath, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, R.ORD_NO AS ordNo FROM REVIEW_REPORT RR INNER JOIN REVIEW R ON RR.REVIEW_NO = R.REVIEW_NO LEFT JOIN PRODUCT P ON R.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO WHERE R.STORE_NO IS NULL AND R.RSV_NO IS NULL AND RR.REP_STATUS = 'WAI' ORDER BY RR.REPORT_NO DESC;

SELECT RR.REPORT_REASON AS reportReason, RR.REPORT_NO AS reportNo, RR.REVIEW_NO AS reviewNo, R.USER_ID AS userId, RR.REPORTER_ID AS reporterId, RR.REP_STATUS AS repStatus, R.R_CONTENTS AS rContents, ( SELECT RF.FILE_PATH FROM REVIEW_FILE RF WHERE RF.REVIEW_NO = R.REVIEW_NO LIMIT 1 ) AS filePath, S.STORE_NAME AS storeName, R.RSV_NO AS rsvNo FROM REVIEW_REPORT RR INNER JOIN REVIEW R ON RR.REVIEW_NO = R.REVIEW_NO LEFT JOIN STORE S ON R.STORE_NO = S.STORE_NO WHERE R.PRODUCT_NO IS NULL AND R.ORD_NO IS NULL AND RR.REP_STATUS = 'WAI' ORDER BY RR.REPORT_NO DESC;

SELECT BR.REPORT_NO AS reportNo, BR.BOARD_NO AS targetNo, BR.REPORTER_ID AS reporterId, B.USER_ID AS reportedUserId, BR.REPORT_REASON AS reportReason, BR.REP_STATUS AS repStatus, ( SELECT BF.FILE_PATH FROM BOARD_FILE BF WHERE BF.BOARD_NO = BR.BOARD_NO ORDER BY BF.FILE_NO ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS filePath FROM BOARD_REPORT BR INNER JOIN BOARD B ON BR.BOARD_NO = B.BOARD_NO WHERE BR.REP_STATUS = 'WAI' ORDER BY BR.REPORT_NO DESC

SELECT BR.REPORT_NO AS reportNo, BR.COMMENT_NO AS targetNo, BR.REPORTER_ID AS reporterId, BR.REPORT_REASON AS reportReason, BR.REP_STATUS AS repStatus, C.USER_ID AS reportedUserId, C.C_CONTENT AS contents, B.BOARD_NO AS boardNo, B.TITLE AS title FROM BOARD_REPORT BR LEFT JOIN COMMENT C ON C.COMMENT_NO = BR.COMMENT_NO LEFT JOIN BOARD B ON C.BOARD_NO = B.BOARD_NO WHERE BR.REP_STATUS = 'WAI' AND BR.COMMENT_NO IS NOT NULL ORDER BY BR.REPORT_NO DESC

SELECT S.STORE_NO AS storeNo, S.STORE_NAME AS storeName, S.S_CATEGORY AS sCategory, S.S_ADDR AS sAddr, S.S_FULL_ADDR AS sFullAddr, S.S_STATUS AS sStatus, S.REJ_REASON AS reportReason, SU.S_USER_ID AS sUserId, SU.CEO_NAME AS ceoName, SU.BIZ_FILE_NAME AS bizFileName, SU.U_STATUS AS uStatus, SS.SUBMIT_STATUS AS submitStatus FROM STORE_SUBMIT SS INNER JOIN STORE S ON SS.STORE_NO = S.STORE_NO INNER JOIN STORE_USER SU ON SS.S_USER_ID = SU.S_USER_ID WHERE SS.S_USER_ID = #{oldSUserId} AND SS.SUBMIT_STATUS = 'REJ' AND S.S_STATUS = 'REJ' AND SU.U_STATUS = 'REJ' ORDER BY SS.STORE_NO DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT STORE_NO AS storeNo, STORE_NAME AS storeName, S_CATEGORY AS sCategory, S_ADDR AS sAddr, S_FULL_ADDR AS sFullAddr, LAT AS lat, LNG AS lng, S_STATUS AS sStatus FROM STORE WHERE ( (S_STATUS = 'EXT' AND S_USER_ID IS NULL) OR (S_STATUS = 'REJ' AND S_USER_ID = #{oldSUserId}) ) AND STORE_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') AND (#{sCategory} IS NULL OR #{sCategory} = '' OR S_CATEGORY = #{sCategory}) AND (#{region} IS NULL OR #{region} = '' OR S_ADDR LIKE CONCAT('%', #{region}, '%')) ORDER BY STORE_NAME LIMIT 50
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STORE WHERE STORE_NO = #{storeNo} AND ( (STORE_NO = #{oldStoreNo} AND S_STATUS = 'REJ' AND S_USER_ID = #{oldSUserId}) OR (S_STATUS = 'EXT' AND S_USER_ID IS NULL) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO STORE_FILE ( STORE_NO, FILE_PATH, FILE_NAME, ORIGIN_NAME, FILE_SIZE, FILE_EXT, IS_MAIN, IS_PROOF ) VALUES ( #{storeNo}, #{filePath}, #{fileName}, #{originName}, #{fileSize}, #{fileExt}, 'N', 'Y' )
mapper.update: UPDATE STORE SET S_STATUS = 'EXT', S_USER_ID = NULL, REJ_REASON = NULL WHERE STORE_NO = #{oldStoreNo} AND STORE_NO != #{storeNo} AND S_STATUS = 'REJ'
UPDATE STORE SET S_STATUS = 'PND', S_USER_ID = #{sUserId}, REJ_REASON = NULL WHERE STORE_NO = #{storeNo}
mapper.select:
SELECT SU.S_USER_ID AS sUserId, SU.CEO_NAME AS ceoName, SU.U_STATUS AS uStatus, S.STORE_NO AS storeNo, S.STORE_NAME AS storeName, S.S_STATUS AS sStatus, S.IS_OPEN AS isOpen,
IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(R.RATING), 1), 0) AS avgRating,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REVIEW_REPORT RR INNER JOIN REVIEW RV ON RR.REVIEW_NO = RV.REVIEW_NO WHERE RV.STORE_NO = S.STORE_NO AND RR.REP_STATUS = 'ACC' ) AS accReportCount,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REVIEW_REPORT RR INNER JOIN REVIEW RV ON RR.REVIEW_NO = RV.REVIEW_NO WHERE RV.STORE_NO = S.STORE_NO AND RR.REP_STATUS = 'REJ' ) AS rejReportCount,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RESERVATION RSV WHERE RSV.STORE_NO = S.STORE_NO ) AS totalReservationCount,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RESERVATION RSV WHERE RSV.STORE_NO = S.STORE_NO AND RSV.RSV_STATUS != 'CAN' ) AS activeReservationCount,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RESERVATION RSV WHERE RSV.STORE_NO = S.STORE_NO AND RSV.RSV_STATUS = 'CAN' ) AS cancelReservationCount
FROM STORE_USER SU INNER JOIN STORE S ON SU.S_USER_ID = S.S_USER_ID LEFT JOIN REVIEW R ON S.STORE_NO = R.STORE_NO WHERE S.S_STATUS != 'EXT'
AND ( SU.S_USER_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR SU.CEO_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR S.STORE_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND S.S_STATUS = #{sStatus}
AND S.IS_OPEN = #{isOpen}
GROUP BY SU.S_USER_ID, SU.CEO_NAME, SU.U_STATUS, S.STORE_NO, S.STORE_NAME, S.S_STATUS, S.IS_OPEN
ORDER BY avgRating DESC, S.STORE_NO DESC
ORDER BY avgRating ASC, S.STORE_NO DESC
ORDER BY activeReservationCount DESC, S.STORE_NO DESC
ORDER BY activeReservationCount ASC, S.STORE_NO DESC
ORDER BY S.STORE_NO DESC
SELECT S_USER_ID AS sUserId, CEO_NAME AS ceoName, BIZ_FILE_NAME AS bizFileName, U_STATUS AS uStatus FROM STORE_USER WHERE S_USER_ID = #{sUserId}

SELECT S.STORE_NO AS storeNo, S.STORE_NAME AS storeName, S.S_CATEGORY AS sCategory, S.BIZNUM AS biznum, S.IS_OPEN AS isOpen, S.ACC_NAME AS accName, S.ACC_NO AS accNo, S.ACC_HOLDER AS accHolder, S.S_ADDR AS sAddr, S.S_FULL_ADDR AS sFullAddr, S.LAT AS lat, S.LNG AS lng, S.S_STATUS AS sStatus,
SP.SLOT AS slot, SP.CAPACITY AS capacity, SP.OPEN_TIME AS openTime, SP.CLOSE_TIME AS closeTime, SP.BREAK_START AS breakStart, SP.BREAK_END AS breakEnd,
SD.SUB_TITLE AS subTitle, SD.S_CONTENTS AS sContents
FROM STORE S LEFT JOIN STORE_POLICY SP ON S.STORE_NO = SP.STORE_NO LEFT JOIN STORE_DETAIL SD ON S.STORE_NO = SD.STORE_NO WHERE S.STORE_NO = #{storeNo}
SELECT MENU_NO AS menuNo, MENU_NAME AS menuName, MENU_PRICE AS menuPrice, M_STATUS AS menuStatus FROM STORE_MENU WHERE STORE_NO = #{storeNo} ORDER BY MENU_NO DESC

SELECT FILE_PATH AS filePath, FILE_NAME AS fileName, ORIGIN_NAME AS originName, IS_PROOF AS isProof, IS_MAIN AS isMain FROM STORE_FILE WHERE STORE_NO = #{storeNo} AND IS_PROOF = 'N' ORDER BY CASE WHEN IS_MAIN = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, FILE_NO DESC
SELECT USER_ID AS userId, RATING AS rating, R_CONTENTS AS rContents, CDATE AS cdate FROM REVIEW WHERE STORE_NO = #{storeNo} ORDER BY CDATE DESC

SELECT RR.REVIEW_NO AS reviewNo, RR.REP_STATUS AS repStatus, RR.REPORTER_ID AS reporterId, R.USER_ID AS userId, RR.REPORT_REASON AS reportReason, RR.CDATE AS cdate FROM REVIEW_REPORT RR INNER JOIN REVIEW R ON RR.REVIEW_NO = R.REVIEW_NO WHERE R.STORE_NO = #{storeNo} AND RR.REP_STATUS IN ('ACC', 'REJ') ORDER BY RR.CDATE DESC

SELECT RSV.RSV_NO AS rsvNo, RSV.RSV_DATE AS rsvDate, RSV.RSV_START_TIME AS rsvStartTime, RSV.RSV_END_TIME AS rsvEndTime, RSV.USER_ID AS userId, RSV.RSV_STATUS AS rsvStatus, RSV.CDATE AS cdate FROM RESERVATION RSV WHERE RSV.STORE_NO = #{storeNo} ORDER BY RSV.RSV_DATE DESC, RSV.RSV_START_TIME DESC

SELECT U.USER_ID AS userId, U.USER_NAME AS userName, U.NICKNAME AS nickname, U.USER_STATUS AS userStatus, U.REP_COUNT AS repCount,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PET P WHERE P.USER_ID = U.USER_ID ) AS petCount,
CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SUBSCRIPTION S WHERE S.USER_ID = U.USER_ID ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS subscriptionYn,
IFNULL(( SELECT SUM(UP.POINT_AMOUNT) FROM USER_POINT UP WHERE UP.USER_ID = U.USER_ID ), 0) AS pointTotal,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USER_COUPON UC WHERE UC.USER_ID = U.USER_ID ) AS couponCount,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDERS O WHERE O.USER_ID = U.USER_ID ) AS orderCount,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RESERVATION R WHERE R.USER_ID = U.USER_ID ) AS reservationCount,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REVIEW R WHERE R.USER_ID = U.USER_ID ) AS reviewCount,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD B WHERE B.USER_ID = U.USER_ID ) + ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `COMMENT` C WHERE C.USER_ID = U.USER_ID ) AS communityCount
FROM USERS U WHERE 1 = 1
AND ( U.USER_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR U.USER_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR U.NICKNAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND U.USER_STATUS = #{userStatus}
ORDER BY U.REP_COUNT DESC, U.CDATE DESC
ORDER BY U.CDATE DESC

SELECT USER_ID AS userId, EMAIL AS email, USER_NAME AS userName, NICKNAME AS nickname, PHONE AS phone, USER_ADDR AS userAddr, FULL_ADDR AS fullAddr, ZIPCODE AS zipcode, SOCIALTYPE AS socialtype, USER_STATUS AS userStatus, CDATE AS cdate FROM USERS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
SELECT PET_NO AS petNo, PET_NAME AS petName, SPECIES AS species, BREED AS breed, BIRTHDATE AS birthdate, GENDER AS gender, CDATE AS cdate FROM PET WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY PET_NO DESC
SELECT S_DATE AS sDate, E_DATE AS eDate, N_DATE AS nDate, SUB_PRICE AS subPrice, SUB_STATUS AS subStatus FROM SUBSCRIPTION WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY S_DATE DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT POINT_NO AS pointNo, POINT_AMOUNT AS pointAmount, ORD_NO AS ordNo, REVIEW_NO AS reviewNo, CDATE AS cdate FROM USER_POINT WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY POINT_NO DESC

SELECT UC.UCP_NO AS ucpNo, C.COUPON_NAME AS couponName, UC.CP_STATUS AS cpStatus, UC.USE_DATE AS useDate, UC.EXP_DATE AS expDate, UC.CDATE AS cdate FROM USER_COUPON UC LEFT JOIN COUPON C ON UC.COUPON_NO = C.COUPON_NO WHERE UC.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY UC.UCP_NO DESC

SELECT ORD_NO AS ordNo, COUPON_NO AS couponNo, POINT_NO AS pointNo, DIS_PRICE AS disPrice, TOTAL_PRICE AS totalPrice, ORD_STATUS AS ordStatus, ORD_ADDR AS ordAddr, DELI_STATUS AS deliStatus, ORD_DATE AS ordDate FROM ORDERS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY ORD_NO DESC

SELECT R.RSV_NO AS rsvNo, R.RSV_DATE AS rsvDate, R.RSV_START_TIME AS rsvStartTime, R.RSV_END_TIME AS rsvEndTime, R.STORE_NO AS storeNo, S.STORE_NAME AS storeName, R.PET_NO AS petNoObj, R.MENU_NO AS menuNo, SM.MENU_NAME AS menuName, R.RSV_STATUS AS rsvStatus, R.CDATE AS cdate FROM RESERVATION R LEFT JOIN STORE S ON R.STORE_NO = S.STORE_NO LEFT JOIN STORE_MENU SM ON R.STORE_NO = SM.STORE_NO AND R.MENU_NO = SM.MENU_NO WHERE R.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY R.RSV_NO DESC

SELECT R.REVIEW_NO AS reviewNo, R.STORE_NO AS storeNo, S.STORE_NAME AS storeName, R.PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, R.RATING AS rating, R.R_CONTENTS AS rContents, R.CDATE AS cdate FROM REVIEW R LEFT JOIN STORE S ON R.STORE_NO = S.STORE_NO LEFT JOIN PRODUCT P ON R.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO WHERE R.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY R.REVIEW_NO DESC

SELECT 'REVIEW' AS reportType, RR.REPORTER_ID AS reporterId, RR.REPORT_REASON AS reportReason, R.R_CONTENTS AS targetContent, NULL AS targetTitle, RR.CDATE AS cdate FROM REVIEW_REPORT RR INNER JOIN REVIEW R ON RR.REVIEW_NO = R.REVIEW_NO WHERE R.USER_ID = #{userId} AND RR.REP_STATUS = 'ACC'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'BOARD' AS reportType, BR.REPORTER_ID AS reporterId, BR.REPORT_REASON AS reportReason, NULL AS targetContent, B.TITLE AS targetTitle, BR.CDATE AS cdate FROM BOARD_REPORT BR INNER JOIN BOARD B ON BR.BOARD_NO = B.BOARD_NO WHERE B.USER_ID = #{userId} AND BR.REP_STATUS = 'ACC' AND BR.BOARD_NO IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'COMMENT' AS reportType, BR.REPORTER_ID AS reporterId, BR.REPORT_REASON AS reportReason, C.C_CONTENT AS targetContent, B.TITLE AS targetTitle, BR.CDATE AS cdate FROM BOARD_REPORT BR INNER JOIN COMMENT C ON BR.COMMENT_NO = C.COMMENT_NO LEFT JOIN BOARD B ON C.BOARD_NO = B.BOARD_NO WHERE C.USER_ID = #{userId} AND BR.REP_STATUS = 'ACC' AND BR.COMMENT_NO IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY cdate DESC
SELECT BOARD_NO AS boardNo, TITLE AS title, CREATE_TIME AS cdate, UPDATE_TIME AS udate FROM BOARD WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY BOARD_NO DESC

SELECT C.COMMENT_NO AS commentNo, C.BOARD_NO AS boardNo, B.TITLE AS title, C.C_CONTENT AS cContent, C.CREATE_TIME AS cdate, C.UPDATE_TIME AS udate FROM `COMMENT` C LEFT JOIN BOARD B ON C.BOARD_NO = B.BOARD_NO WHERE C.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY C.COMMENT_NO DESC

SELECT S.STORE_NO AS storeNo, S.STORE_NAME AS storeName, COUNT(*) AS reportCount FROM REVIEW_REPORT RR INNER JOIN REVIEW R ON RR.REVIEW_NO = R.REVIEW_NO LEFT JOIN STORE S ON R.STORE_NO = S.STORE_NO WHERE R.PRODUCT_NO IS NULL AND R.ORD_NO IS NULL AND RR.REP_STATUS = 'WAI' GROUP BY S.STORE_NO, S.STORE_NAME ORDER BY reportCount DESC, S.STORE_NO DESC

SELECT RR.REPORT_NO AS reportNo, RR.REVIEW_NO AS reviewNo, RR.REPORTER_ID AS reporterId, RR.REPORT_REASON AS reportReason, RR.REP_STATUS AS repStatus, R.USER_ID AS userId, R.R_CONTENTS AS rContents, R.RSV_NO AS rsvNo, S.STORE_NO AS storeNo, S.STORE_NAME AS storeName, IFNULL(SM.MENU_NAME, '삭제된 메뉴') AS menuName, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(RF.FILE_PATH, RF.FILE_NAME) ORDER BY RF.FILE_NO ASC SEPARATOR '|') FROM REVIEW_FILE RF WHERE RF.REVIEW_NO = R.REVIEW_NO ) AS filePath FROM REVIEW_REPORT RR INNER JOIN REVIEW R ON RR.REVIEW_NO = R.REVIEW_NO LEFT JOIN STORE S ON R.STORE_NO = S.STORE_NO LEFT JOIN RESERVATION RSV ON R.RSV_NO = RSV.RSV_NO LEFT JOIN STORE_MENU SM ON RSV.MENU_NO = SM.MENU_NO WHERE R.STORE_NO = #{storeNo} AND R.PRODUCT_NO IS NULL AND R.ORD_NO IS NULL AND RR.REP_STATUS = 'WAI' ORDER BY RR.REPORT_NO DESC

SELECT BR.BOARD_NO AS targetNo, BR.BOARD_NO AS boardNo, B.TITLE AS title, B.USER_ID AS reportedUserId, COUNT(*) AS reportCount FROM BOARD_REPORT BR INNER JOIN BOARD B ON BR.BOARD_NO = B.BOARD_NO WHERE BR.REP_STATUS = 'WAI' AND BR.BOARD_NO IS NOT NULL GROUP BY BR.BOARD_NO, B.TITLE, B.USER_ID ORDER BY reportCount DESC, BR.BOARD_NO DESC

SELECT BR.REPORT_NO AS reportNo, BR.BOARD_NO AS targetNo, BR.BOARD_NO AS boardNo, BR.REPORTER_ID AS reporterId, B.USER_ID AS reportedUserId, BR.REPORT_REASON AS reportReason, BR.REP_STATUS AS repStatus, B.TITLE AS title FROM BOARD_REPORT BR INNER JOIN BOARD B ON BR.BOARD_NO = B.BOARD_NO WHERE BR.BOARD_NO = #{targetNo} AND BR.REP_STATUS = 'WAI' ORDER BY BR.REPORT_NO DESC

SELECT BR.COMMENT_NO AS targetNo, B.BOARD_NO AS boardNo, B.TITLE AS title, C.C_CONTENT AS contents, C.USER_ID AS reportedUserId, COUNT(*) AS reportCount FROM BOARD_REPORT BR INNER JOIN COMMENT C ON BR.COMMENT_NO = C.COMMENT_NO INNER JOIN BOARD B ON C.BOARD_NO = B.BOARD_NO WHERE BR.REP_STATUS = 'WAI' AND BR.COMMENT_NO IS NOT NULL GROUP BY BR.COMMENT_NO, B.BOARD_NO, B.TITLE, C.C_CONTENT, C.USER_ID ORDER BY reportCount DESC, BR.COMMENT_NO DESC

SELECT BR.REPORT_NO AS reportNo, BR.COMMENT_NO AS targetNo, B.BOARD_NO AS boardNo, BR.REPORTER_ID AS reporterId, C.USER_ID AS reportedUserId, BR.REPORT_REASON AS reportReason, BR.REP_STATUS AS repStatus, B.TITLE AS title FROM BOARD_REPORT BR INNER JOIN COMMENT C ON BR.COMMENT_NO = C.COMMENT_NO INNER JOIN BOARD B ON C.BOARD_NO = B.BOARD_NO WHERE BR.COMMENT_NO = #{targetNo} AND BR.REP_STATUS = 'WAI' ORDER BY BR.REPORT_NO DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE REVIEW_REPORT RR INNER JOIN REVIEW R ON RR.REVIEW_NO = R.REVIEW_NO SET RR.REP_STATUS = 'ACC' WHERE R.STORE_NO = #{storeNo} AND RR.REP_STATUS = 'WAI'
UPDATE REVIEW_REPORT RR INNER JOIN REVIEW R ON RR.REVIEW_NO = R.REVIEW_NO SET RR.REP_STATUS = 'REJ' WHERE R.STORE_NO = #{storeNo} AND RR.REP_STATUS = 'WAI'
UPDATE BOARD_REPORT SET REP_STATUS = 'ACC' WHERE BOARD_NO = #{targetNo} AND REP_STATUS = 'WAI'
UPDATE BOARD_REPORT SET REP_STATUS = 'REJ' WHERE BOARD_NO = #{targetNo} AND REP_STATUS = 'WAI'
UPDATE BOARD_REPORT SET REP_STATUS = 'ACC' WHERE COMMENT_NO = #{targetNo} AND REP_STATUS = 'WAI'
UPDATE BOARD_REPORT SET REP_STATUS = 'REJ' WHERE COMMENT_NO = #{targetNo} AND REP_STATUS = 'WAI'
